question.text: The pH and conductance of a weak acid (HX) was found to be 5 and $4 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{~S}$, respectively. The conductance was measured under standard condition using a cell where the electrode plates having a surface area of $1 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$ were at a distance of 15 cm apart. The value of the limiting molar conductivity is $\_\_\_\_$ $\mathrm{S} \mathrm{m}^{2} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$. (nearest integer) (Given : degree of dissociation of the weak acid $(\alpha) \ll 1$)
